events.title: Dhaka AI & Cloud Engineering Summit 2026
events.tagline: Bangladesh's flagship engineering summit on LLMs, distributed systems & FinTech infrastructure.
events.description: Join 500+ software engineers, AI researchers, CTOs, and university computer club leaders at KIB Complex, Dhaka. Featuring hands-on production case studies from Bangladesh's top engineering teams, Bangla LLM fine-tuning labs, and cloud architecture clinics.

agenda.title: Keynote: Scaling FinTech Payments to 50M Users in Bangladesh
agenda.speaker: Dr. Mahbubur Rahman

agenda.title: Workshop: Production RAG & Bangla Voice Agents
agenda.speaker: Nusrat Jahan & Team

events.refund_policy: Full refund up to 72 hours before event start; ticket transfer allowed anytime.

events.title: BUET CSE Fest 2026 — National Hackathon & IUPC
events.tagline: 36-hour inter-university hackathon, AI challenge, and robotics showcase at Palashi.
events.description: Organized by BUET Computer Club, the annual CSE Fest brings together teams from 45+ universities across Bangladesh for competitive programming, 36-hour hackathon sprints, and industry mentorship.

agenda.title: Hackathon Problem Statement Reveal
agenda.speaker: Prof. A. K. M. Ashikur Rahman

events.refund_policy: Team registration fees are non-refundable after team shortlisting.

events.title: Product Design & Accessible Design Systems Workshop
events.tagline: Hands-on Figma component tokens, WCAG accessibility, and design-to-code handoff.
events.description: A practical Saturday afternoon workshop at EMK Center, Gulshan-2 for UI/UX designers, frontend developers, and university design enthusiasts. Free community registration with strictly capped seating.
events.refund_policy: Free community event. Please cancel at least 24 hours prior if unable to attend.

events.title: NSU National Startup Pitch & Venture Day 2026
events.tagline: Bangladesh university founders pitch live to angel investors and VC funds.
events.description: Hosted by NSU Young Entrepreneurs Society (YES!), Venture Day connects top student-led startups with local and regional venture capital partners, angel syndicates, and ecosystem builders.
events.refund_policy: Refundable up to 5 days prior to the event.

events.title: Chattogram Cloud Native & Kubernetes Day
events.tagline: Container orchestration, observability, and zero-downtime deployments at CUET IT Incubator.
events.description: Bringing hands-on cloud-native engineering workshops to Chattogram's growing developer and university community at Sheikh Kamal IT Business Incubator, CUET.
events.refund_policy: Full refund available up to 48 hours before event.

events.title: Full-Stack Next.js & PostgreSQL Architecture Clinic (Online)
events.tagline: Live interactive code-along on modular monoliths, Row-Level Security, and payment webhooks.
events.description: Join from anywhere in Bangladesh! We walk through building resilient modular monoliths with Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL transactions.

agenda.title: Architecture Deep-Dive: Why Modular Monoliths Win
agenda.speaker: Nusrat Jahan

agenda.title: Idempotent Payment Webhooks & Atomic Inventory Locks
agenda.speaker: Live Coding

events.title: Dhaka Indie Music & Acoustic Fest 2026
events.tagline: An intimate live evening celebrating indie bands, folk fusion, and acoustic songwriters.
events.description: Experience a soulful acoustic night in Dhaka featuring 6 emerging indie bands and folk-fusion vocalists at EMK Center, Gulshan. Seating is strictly limited to ensure an exceptional live listening experience with state-of-the-art studio sound.

agenda.title: Opening Acoustic Sets: Folk & Indie Solos
agenda.speaker: Guest Songwriters

events.refund_policy: Refunds available up to 48 hours before the concert.

events.title: Bangladesh FinTech & Digital Banking Summit 2026
events.tagline: Connecting mobile financial services, central bank regulators, and payment architects.
events.description: The premier annual summit on Bangladesh financial infrastructure. Deep dive into MFS interoperability, national QR payments, real-time fraud defense, and agent banking networks with industry executives and engineering leaders.

agenda.title: Keynote: The Future of Interoperable Micro-Payments
agenda.speaker: Central Banking Forum

agenda.title: Panel: AI-Powered Fraud Detection at MFS Scale
agenda.speaker: Security Engineering Leads

events.refund_policy: Full refund up to 7 days before event start.

events.title: Sylhet AI & Machine Learning Winter Camp
events.tagline: Hands-on PyTorch, computer vision, and generative AI pipelines for students and developers.
events.description: A weekend boot camp bringing world-class AI engineering curriculum to Sylhet. Learn transformer models, local dataset fine-tuning, and production deployment with GPU acceleration.

agenda.title: Fine-tuning Small Language Models for Bangla
agenda.speaker: Lab 2

events.refund_policy: Refundable up to 72 hours before workshop start.

events.title: National Bangla NLP & Open LLM Hackathon 2026
events.tagline: 30-hour national hackathon building open Bangla datasets, tokenizers, and language applications.
events.description: Gathering university teams from across the nation to solve real-world Bangla language processing challenges in healthcare, legal tech, and education. Mentored by industry AI researchers.
events.refund_policy: Team registration fee is refundable if withdrawn before team verification.

events.title: Dhaka Rock & Underground Metal Fest 2026
events.tagline: Featuring Artcell, Nemesis, AvoidRafa, and Karnival live on one historic stage.
events.description: Bangladesh's premier rock and metal showcase returns to KIB Auditorium, Farmgate. Featuring 8 iconic and breakthrough rock acts, premium sound engineering, and exclusive band merchandise zones.
events.refund_policy: Tickets are strictly non-refundable within 48 hours of showtime.

events.title: Bangladesh Agentic AI & Autonomous Systems Hackathon 2026
events.tagline: Build autonomous multi-agent swarms, local Bangla vector embeddings, and real-time tooling.
events.description: A high-intensity 48-hour builder hackathon hosted at BUET ECE Auditorium. Engineers, researchers, and students compete to build production-grade agentic workflows with local open-source LLMs and cloud APIs.
events.refund_policy: Refunds allowed up to 5 days before hackathon kickoff.

events.title: Bangladesh Venture Capital & Startup Conclave 2026
events.tagline: Connecting 60+ venture funds, high-growth Bangladeshi founders, and regional angel syndicates.
events.description: The premier investor-founder gathering at NSU Main Auditorium, Bashundhara R/A. Featuring structured 1:1 speed-pitching, cross-border remittance panel, and founder masterclasses.

agenda.title: Fireside Chat: Navigating Series A in South Asia
agenda.speaker: Farhana Rahman & Guests

agenda.title: Curated 1:1 Pitch Rounds with 25 VC Firms
agenda.speaker: Meeting Suites

events.refund_policy: Full refund available up to 72 hours before event.

events.title: Sylhet Tea Valley Acoustic & Sufi Folk Night 2026
events.tagline: A mystical evening of Baul folk melodies, Sylheti Dhamail traditions, and modern acoustic fusion.
events.description: Set in the cultural heart of Sylhet at Kazi Nazrul Islam Auditorium, Rikabi Bazar. Featuring master Baul musicians, traditional folk instruments, and contemporary acoustic vocalists.
events.refund_policy: Refundable up to 48 hours prior to performance.

events.title: Dhaka UI/UX & Design Systems Conclave 2026
events.tagline: Mastering multi-platform design tokens, Bengali typography, and motion design at scale.
events.description: Join top product designers, creative directors, and UX researchers at EMK Center, Gulshan-2 for a full day of design critiques, token architecture labs, and portfolio reviews.
events.refund_policy: Refunds accepted up to 3 days before the event.

rfq_messages.message_text: Assalamu Alaikum Kamal Bhai. Can we enter at 07:00 AM for stage backdrop setup instead of 08:00 AM?
Walaikum Assalam Nusrat Apa. Yes, 07:00 AM entry for production crew is approved without extra charge.

messages.content: Compare the venue quote and tell me if the generator backup is included.

In the quotation from Krishibid Institution Bangladesh (KIB), continuous heavy generator power backup (200kVA fuel included) is explicitly listed as Line Item 2 for ৳5,000, with a ৳5,000 academic discount offsetting it. Total venue rental is ৳85,000.
